items.definition:
belonging to or typical of the aristocracy.
He had an aristocratic bearing.

mysterious or obscure in meaning
He left a cryptic message on the answering machine.

in an early stage of development
The project is still in its embryonic stage.

relating to a governor
The gubernatorial election will be held next month.

debatable; irrelevant
The point became moot after the new evidence was presented.

relating to or involving catalysis
The enzyme played a catalytic role in the chemical reaction.

relating to the geologic period
Dinosaurs lived during the Cretaceous period.

wrong, incorrect
His calculations were erroneous.

not having any serious purpose or value
She made a frivolous purchase of a new hat.

uniform in structure or composition
The population was remarkably homogeneous.

unable to be touched or grasped; not having physical presence
Goodwill is an intangible asset.

relating to metaphysics; abstract
The philosopher discussed the metaphysical aspects of existence.

having an excessive interest in oneself and one's physical appearance
His narcissistic tendencies made it difficult for him to empathize with others.

relating to an artificial body part
He was fitted with a prosthetic leg after the accident.

opposing political or social progress or reform
His views were considered reactionary by many progressives.

given, felt, or done in return
They had a reciprocal agreement to help each other.

relating to the apostles or their teachings
The Pope's authority is considered apostolic by many Catholics.

relating to the chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms
Researchers are studying the biochemical pathways involved in the disease.

kept secret or done secretively, especially because illicit
They held a clandestine meeting under the cover of darkness.

oval-shaped; (of language) obscure or indirect
The planet follows an elliptical orbit around the sun.

fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
She delivered an eloquent speech that moved everyone in the audience.

brave; heroic; (of a man) charmingly attentive to women
The knight was known for his gallant deeds and chivalry.

situated in the middle; relating to the median
The medial nerve runs down the arm.

relating to trade or commerce; commercial
The city has a rich mercantile history.

relating to or characterized by philanthropy; benevolent
The billionaire was known for his philanthropic endeavors.

allowing light to pass through but not clearly
The frosted glass was translucent, letting light in but obscuring the view.

relating to cultivated land or the cultivation of land
The country has a predominantly agrarian economy.

made to order for a particular customer
He ordered a bespoke suit for the wedding.

shockingly bad; disgraceful
The living conditions in the old building were deplorable.

extremely delicate and light in a way that seems too perfect for this world
Her ethereal beauty captivated everyone in the room.

High-class; fashionable.
She admired the haute couture designs on the runway.

indirect; slanting
He made an oblique reference to the problem without directly addressing it.

(of love or friendship) intimate and affectionate but not sexual
They had a purely platonic relationship, based on mutual respect.

loyal, firm
She is a staunch supporter of human rights.

crossing the Atlantic Ocean
She booked a transatlantic flight to London.

having no equal or parallel
His talent is truly unparalleled.

not requested or invited
He received a lot of unsolicited advice.

having a shape that reduces drag from air moving past it.
The car's aerodynamic design helps it go faster.

relating to or involving algebra.
We need to solve this algebraic equation.

involved in an illegal or questionable act
He was found complicit in the fraud scheme.

cowardly
The craven knight refused to face the dragon.

relating to an imagined state or society where there is great suffering or injustice
The novel depicts a bleak dystopian future.

relating to the Germanic peoples or languages
English is a Germanic language.

Crude and offensive in a sexual way.
He was fired for making lewd comments to his colleagues.

not existing
The evidence for his claims was completely nonexistent.

elaborately or highly decorated
The ornate carvings on the old building were impressive.

able to be touched or felt; clear to the mind or senses
There was a palpable sense of tension in the room.

showing a deliberate and obstinate desire to behave in a way that is unreasonable or unacceptable
He took a perverse delight in annoying his colleagues.

relating to a symphony orchestra
The New York Philharmonic performed a classical concert.

accurately describing or predicting what will happen in the future
His words proved to be prophetic, as the event unfolded exactly as he predicted.

of or concerning schools and education
He excelled in all his scholastic endeavors.

not having the necessary qualifications; complete
He gave his unqualified support to the proposal.

involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring
The climb to the summit was long and arduous.

very severe or serious
He suffered a grievous injury in the accident.

full of danger or risk
The climbers faced a perilous journey up the icy mountain.

relating to or depicting sexual subjects in a way that is intended to cause sexual excitement
The website was shut down for distributing pornographic material.

arousing intense distaste or disgust
The smell from the garbage dump was utterly repulsive.

deriving pleasure from inflicting pain, suffering, or humiliation on others
The villain displayed a sadistic grin as he tortured his captives.

extending or operating across national boundaries
Many transnational corporations operate globally.

relating to a disease caused by antibodies or lymphocytes produced against substances naturally present in the body
She suffers from an autoimmune disease that affects her joints.

sharing a common border; touching
The 48 contiguous states of the USA are connected.

impossible to understand
The instructions were completely incomprehensible.

unable to be endured
The noise from the construction site was intolerable.

attempting to impress by affecting greater importance, talent, culture, etc., than is actually possessed
His speech was full of pretentious jargon that no one understood.
